A dominant chase from the Lions!
After restricting Emirates Eagles to 109/4, Yas Lions chased down the target in just 8.4 overs, sealing an emphatic 8-wicket victory! James Vince led the charge with a blistering 47 off 24, while David Willey starred with the ball, picking up 2/12 to earn Player of the Match!
